entity.summary: Centralized cryptocurrency exchange that announced an orderly wind-down on 2026-07-14 after UK sanctions affected the EXMO.com group. New registrations and deposits were closed, trading was restricted to closing/conversion activity, and withdrawals remained available for the distribution of unfrozen user assets.
entity.notes: The official About page states that EXMO.com was founded in 2014. The UK designated EXMO EXCHANGE LIMITED on 2026-05-26 under the Russia sanctions regime. On 2026-07-14 EXMO.com announced an orderly wind-down, stating that operations had been almost completely paralyzed, new registrations and deposits were closed, and trading was limited to closing/conversion use while withdrawals continued. No final shutdown date is established in the reviewed evidence, so HEI classifies EXMO as limited rather than dead and keeps death_reason/death_date null.

events.title: UK designated EXMO EXCHANGE LIMITED under Russia sanctions
events.description: The United Kingdom added EXMO EXCHANGE LIMITED to its Russia sanctions list, imposing measures including an asset freeze, trust-services sanctions, director disqualification, internet-services sanctions, and correspondent-banking and payment-processing restrictions.
events.notes: This records the UK designation itself. The later EXMO wind-down announcement provides first-party evidence of the operational consequences.

events.title: EXMO announced an orderly wind-down and closure
events.description: EXMO.com announced that it had begun an orderly wind-down after sanctions left operations almost completely paralyzed. It closed new registrations and deposits, restricted trading to closing/conversion activity, and urged users to withdraw unfrozen assets.
events.notes: The announcement establishes a wind-down but not a final effective shutdown date. Withdrawal and limited conversion functionality remained available, so the entity is not marked dead.

events.title: EU adopted transaction restrictions naming EXMO
events.description: The European Union adopted its 21st Russia sanctions package and listed EXMO Ltd in Annex XIX Part A, with the transaction restriction taking effect on 2026-08-23.
events.notes: This is a jurisdiction-specific regulatory event and does not by itself establish the final effective closure date of EXMO.com.

evidence.title: About EXMO.com crypto exchange
evidence.notes: First-party About page states that EXMO.com was founded in 2014 and operated as a global cryptocurrency trading platform.

evidence.title: EXMO official exchange website
evidence.notes: Historical current-status capture predating the later July 2026 wind-down announcement.

evidence.title: EXMO exchange discovery entries
evidence.notes: Secondary exchange registry corroborates EXMO identity; duplicate registry rows are consolidated into one entity.

evidence.title: List of Russia sanctions designations, 26 May 2026
evidence.notes: Primary UK government source lists EXMO EXCHANGE LIMITED among the 2026-05-26 Russia sanctions designations. The accompanying sanctions notice records asset-freeze, trust-services, director-disqualification, internet-services, and correspondent-banking/payment-processing measures.

evidence.title: EXMO.com is closing
evidence.notes: First-party closure notice states that EXMO.com began an orderly wind-down after sanctions almost completely paralyzed operations, closed registrations and deposits, limited trading to closing/conversion use, and asked users to withdraw unfrozen assets.

evidence.title: Council Decision (CFSP) 2026/1849
evidence.notes: Primary legal source listing EXMO Ltd in Annex XIX Part A with an effective date of 2026-08-23.

evidence.title: EU adds HTX to Russia sanctions list, barring transactions starting Aug. 23
evidence.notes: Independent reporting identifies EXMO among the platforms listed alongside HTX and corroborates the 2026-08-23 effective date.
